$comment: Generated from the program by opensloper-cli doc blender.schema.json; do not edit it by hand.
title: OpenSloper blender scene file (.blender.json)
description: Written by opensloper-cli drape from a drape file, for Blender's cloth simulation, and never read back. Its meshes are OBJ files beside it, in mm with the drape's axes: the pieces', each in its own frame with its anchor at the origin and the right side of the fabric facing -y, and the body's, as placed. Vertices are counted from 0 within each object, in the order the OBJ file lists them.

format.description: What the file is; a file with another value does not load

version.description: The version of the format, from 1

units.description: Always mm: values in this file are millimetres

pieces.description: The pieces' OBJ file, relative to this file's folder: one object for each entry of objects, in the same order and with the same names

body.description: The body's OBJ file, relative to this file's folder; left out when the drape has no body

spacing.description: About how far apart the meshes' points are

objects.description: Every placed copy of a piece that could be meshed

name.description: Its object's name in the OBJ file: the pattern file's name, the piece's and the copy

source.description: The drape file's source the piece is from

piece.description: The piece's ID in its pattern

copy.description: Which copy of the piece, from 1

mirrored.description: Whether the copy is cut mirrored, as the left of a pair; its mesh is mirrored already

material.description: The name of the material it is cut from; left out when it has none

color.description: The colour to show it in, as #RRGGBB

vertices.description: How many vertices its mesh has

position.description: Where its origin goes: the object's location

rotation.description: Its turns in degrees, in Blender's XYZ Euler order: the object's rotation_euler

attached.description: Its vertices held to the body, or where they are placed when there is no body: those of its attached edges, from 0

seams.description: The seams between placed copies, each with the vertices it sews together

source.description: The source the seam is from

seam.description: The seam's ID in its pattern

pairs.description: Pairs of vertices to sew together, each an object (its place in objects, from 0) and a vertex of it
